main_text.head: SUMMARIA
main_text.l: 370. Ob eas liber sextus in Gallia non est receptus.
371. Seculo XIV. Clemens V. Clementinas collegit.
373. Regulae Cancellariae auctorem habent Johannem XXII. nem XXII.
374. Joan. XXII. multa pro sede Romana invenit, nempe Reg. Cancell.
381. Quid sint regulae Cancellariae & cujus sit auctoritatis.
384. Corpus Juris Canonici comparatum cum Corpore Juris Civilis.
387. Quenam Doctorum Virorum judicia de jure Canonico.

page.notes: Line 373 and 374 are broken across lines; "Johan-nem" is hyphenated at line end. Line 373 second line reads "nem XXII." as printed. Line 381 end line reads "auctoritatis." Printed text continues on the next part. The numerals 382–388 and the initial letters of several entries are partly lost in the scan; the last entry is cut off at the edge. The lower-right watermark is the digitiser's and is left out.
